description: This is a CMake configuration file that checks for the presence of the dbus-client library and sets up an imported library target if found. It configures how to locate the library and include header files for use in the build system.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Finds and loads settings for a package, here used to find PkgConfig.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Uses pkg-config to get the compiler and linker flags for dbus-client.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates the library file for dbus_client.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported target for the dbus-client library.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties on the imported library target, such as include directories and libraries.
